Delhi Traffic Alert Issued for CJP's 'Lehra Do Tiranga' March

Delhi traffic police have issued an advisory due to a proposed 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) scheduled for today. The march is planned for 5 PM at Central Park in Connaught Place. In anticipation of the event, Delhi Police has imposed Section 163 in Connaught Place and released a traffic advisory for several key routes, warning of potential severe traffic jams affecting millions. Central Park has been closed for administrative reasons on October 16 and 17.
